title: Decision
description: A locked or superseded design decision recorded in the Feedback & Decisions Log.

id.description: Unique identifier — D-01, D-P2-01, D-P3-01, etc.

phase.description: Phase number this decision primarily belongs to (1, 2, 3, 4, or 'cross').

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary for the RTM Source Index.

made_by.description: Person, team, or source that made the decision.

date.description: ISO date the decision was made (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if unknown.

superseded_by.description: ID of the decision that supersedes this one, or null.

supersedes.description: IDs of decisions this decision supersedes.

change_risk.description: Risk level if this decision is revised.

confidence.description: Confidence level of this decision's source.

evidence_type.description: Type of evidence that supports this decision.

source_ref.description: Human-readable source reference (meeting name, page title, etc.).

source_date.description: ISO date the source was produced.

documents_reflect.description: Document codes where this decision MUST be reflected (✓ in RTM). Use short codes: 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, KB2, KB3, FDL.

documents_check.description: Document codes that should be reviewed for indirect impact (↻ in RTM).

workflows.description: Workflow track IDs affected by this decision.

phases_affected.description: Phase numbers affected by this decision.

oqs_created.description: Open Question IDs created as a result of this decision.

oqs_resolved.description: Open Question IDs resolved by this decision.

body.description: Full decision text as it appears in the Feedback & Decisions Log.

notes.description: Optional clarifying notes, caveats, or cross-references not in the main body.
